chunks: Whatever is in it from Hisham ibn Ibrahim, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Hisham ibn Ibrahim, the companion of al-Rida عليه السلام.

key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; the author’s statement of direct narration through the cited chain.
key_terms.صَاحِبِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Companion of Imam al-Rida عليه السلام, identifying Hisham ibn Ibrahim’s association.
key_terms.عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: From Hisham ibn Ibrahim as the source of transmission in this sanad/isnad.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Hisham ibn Ibrahim in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad by which the author transmits reports from Hisham ibn Ibrahim. It serves as a chain-of-transmission notice identifying the intermediaries linking the author to a companion of Imam al-Rida عليه السلام.
